error[ZC-E0806]: a peer key or trust file can't be used
  cause  the CA key file <state>/ca.key is readable by other users (mode 0644)
  fix    set its mode to 0600, or delete it so the server creates a new CA
  more   zcube explain E0806 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0806.html
